question: List Breast trials requiring a biomarker other than PD‑L1 for inclusion.

gemini.answer: This query retrieves the NCT ID, author, year and PubMed ID of all breast cancer clinical trials which have biomarker inclusion criteria other than PD-L1.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"cancer_type\" = 'Breast (TNBC)' AND \"other_biomarker_inclusion\" = 'Yes'",
  "answer": "This query retrieves the NCT ID, author, year and PubMed ID of all breast cancer clinical trials which have biomarker inclusion criteria other than PD-L1.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
